LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FOR COMPREHENSION – PLAY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we enhance comprehension when reading a play?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary on indigenous trade from a play for information
2. respond to questions from a play for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 6.2.1 READING FOR COMPREHENSION – PLAY
This lesson teaches Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play for Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vocabulary on indigenous trade from a play for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. respond to questions from a play for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play above.
2. Explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we enhance comprehension when reading a play?
2. How does indigenous trade differ from modern trade?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary on indigenous trade from a play for information
2. respond to questions from a play for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
